extraction.teacher_style: The instructor breaks down Cuban Casino basic steps clearly, using explicit technical descriptions of weight transfer and rhythm. He demonstrates variations from the back and front with verbal cadence cues.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to 5 basic steps for Cuban Casino
Practicing the sequence with music and party lights

common_mistakes: Taking hold the pause too literally and stopping the whole movement
Letting the whole body go back uncontrollably on back rocks

steps_taught.name: Two Step
steps_taught.description: Tapping and stepping out with weight transfer on alternate counts

steps_taught.name: Paso de Son
steps_taught.description: In-place quick steps transitioning into a slow step out

steps_taught.name: Back Rocks
steps_taught.description: Stepping back at the heel with weight change underneath

steps_taught.name: Back Cross
steps_taught.description: Stepping back, crossing to the middle, and stepping out

steps_taught.name: Walk & Pivot
steps_taught.description: Walking steps followed by a pivot on the slow beat

what_works: Clear distinction between taps and steps
Detailed explanation of weight transfer mechanics

It's going to be quick, quick, slow.
The cool thing about these steps is that they're a series.
